subject: ALS Ice Bucket Challenge Participation
overview: Mayor McGlynn accepted the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge during a press conference and nominated three residents to participate next.

items.title: ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
items.summary: Mayor McGlynn accepted a challenge from Kelly Ranara-South to raise awareness for Lou Gehrig’s disease and nominated Anne Fretz, Jim Silva, and George L. Sacco Jr. to participate next.
